name: plugin-live
description: Live plugin control for the RUNNING workstation service: declares plugin rows in the HMR-watched HOME patch layer and waits until the harness Loader has mounted/disposed them - no container recreate, no service restart, no release path. Tools: 'plugin list', 'plugin add', 'plugin remove'

config.description: Both fields have production-safe defaults; the plugin drives the harness' own patch/loader machinery.

patchFile.description: Absolute path of the live patch layer the tools write (default: $DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml, the HOME patch the harness watches).

waitMs.description: Default wait budget of 'plugin add'/'plugin remove' until the Loader reflects the change (default 15000, capped at 60000).
